description: Trace a URL's redirect chain hop by hop (up to 10 hops, 8 s each) with status, location, timing and scheme per hop. Flags chains over two redirects, loops, HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrades, 302s used for www or https canonicalisation, dropped paths or query strings, cross-domain moves, meta-refresh or JS redirects on a 200, and a final page that is not 200.
name: trace_redirects
